items.docs:
Find the next available panelist for a given specialty
      If patient id is provided and this patient has seen a specialist in the past
      1. Select last seen specialist if available on the next 24 hrs
      2. If last seen specialist is not available on the next 24 hrs
      but he is available in the next 30 days, send both the last seen and next
      available panelist to frontend so requester can choose either
      3. If last seen specialist is not available at all, send both the last
